  "evidence_quote": "Tom initially cut off 7 cm from each board to make them the same size.",
  "evidence_start": null,
  "evidence_end": null,
  "evidence_occurrence": 1,
  "question_evidence_quote": "He decides to cut 25 cm off the board. But it turned out longer than the other boards. He had to cut off 7 cm from each to make them the same size.",
  "observed_error": "The response places the 7 cm cut before the 25 cm cut.",
  "violated_condition": "The question places the 25 cm removal before the subsequent 7 cm removal.",
  "error_description": "The response describes the 7 cm removal as Tom’s initial cut and then explicitly places the 25 cm removal afterward. This reverses the stated chronology: Tom first shortened the 143 cm board by 25 cm, and the 7 cm cuts occurred subsequently.",
  "reference_review_reason": "The reference assumes the other boards were 7 cm longer than the shortened board, whereas the question says the shortened board was longer than the others. The intended board lengths therefore require clarification.",
  "secondary_errors": [
    "The response identifies 143 cm as the final length, although it is the length before the subsequent removals.",
    "The response subtracts 7 cm when reconstructing a length before a 7 cm removal, contradicting its own statement that the earlier length was 7 cm longer. The subtraction itself is computed correctly."
  ],
  "uncertainty_note": "The question's inconsistent description of the other boards does not prevent identifying the reversed order of the cuts."
}
